concepts.title: Drum Kit Orientation
concepts.summary: Identify the kick, snare, hi-hat, and toms, and sit with balanced posture.

concepts.title: Stick Grip
concepts.summary: Hold the sticks with a relaxed fulcrum and loose fingers.

concepts.title: Basic Strokes
concepts.summary: Produce even wrist strokes with a controlled rebound.

concepts.title: Kick and Snare Independence
concepts.summary: Coordinate the kick and snare feet and hands in simple patterns.

concepts.title: Quarter-Note Pulse
concepts.summary: Keep a steady quarter-note pulse with the hi-hat.

concepts.title: Eighth-Note Groove
concepts.summary: Play a basic rock groove: hi-hat eighths with kick and snare accents.

concepts.title: Basic Fills
concepts.summary: Move around the kit with a short fill that returns to the groove.
Hold a groove at different tempos without speeding up or dragging.

concepts.title: Simple Drum Song
concepts.summary: Perform a short pattern of groove and fill with a steady tempo.

edges.rationale: The learner must know the kit before holding the sticks.
Foot independence requires knowing which drum is which.
Even strokes need a stable grip.
A steady pulse is even strokes in time.
The groove coordinates kick and snare with the hi-hat.
A fill interrupts and returns to the groove.
Tempo control is the groove at different speeds.
The final pattern combines groove and fill.
The final performance must hold one tempo.
